c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

傢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 家 represents the sound.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

谢.o: Simplified form of 謝. Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 射 represents the sound.
x: 多谢救命之恩。
Duōxiè jiùmìngzhī'ēn.
Thank you for saving my life.
这次你帮了大忙，谢谢！
Zhècì nǐ bāng le dà máng, xièxie!
You've been a great help this time, thank you!
感谢得很！
Gǎnxiè de hěn!
[I/We] greatly appreciate [that]!

c.h: Depicts the outline of a face.

面.o: Depicts the outline of a face, with an eye (目) in the middle. In simplified Chinese 面 is also used to mean "noodles", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 麵.
w: outside (also pr. for this sense); surface
x: 我和他只见过一面。
Wǒ hé tā zhǐ jiàn guo yī miàn.
I have only met him once.
您觉得我们应该从哪方面入手呢？
Nín juéde wǒmen yīnggāi cóng nǎ fāngmiàn rùshǒu ne?
Where do you think we should start?
我被锁在门外面了。
Wǒ bèi suǒ zài mén wàimiàn le.
I was locked out.

呢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 尼 represents the sound. 口 (mouth) indicates that the character is only "mouthed", i.e. only used for its phonetic value.
w: comes at the end of the sentence to indicate a strong degree
x: 你爸爸好吗？你妈妈呢？
Nǐ bàba hǎo ma? Nǐ māma ne?
How is your father? And your mom?
你觉得呢？
Nǐ juéde ne?
What do you think?

c.h: Shorthand for the 雚 component in the traditional character 歡.
Depicts a person opening their mouth to laugh.

欢.o: Simplified form of 歡. Phonosemantic compound. 欠 represents the meaning and 雚 represents the sound. 欠 (yawn) is a pictograph of a person with an open mouth, used here to represent a person joyfully laughing.
w: to like; to be fond of
x: 火烧得很欢。
Huǒ shāo de hěn huān.
The fire is burning cheerfully.
你喜欢这本书吗？
Nǐ xǐhuan zhè běn shū ma?
Do you like this book?
我的店铺下个星期开张，欢迎各位亲朋好友前来。
Wǒ de diànpù xià ge xīngqī kāizhāng, huānyíng gèwèi qīnpénghǎoyǒu qiánlái.
My shop will open for business next week, and all my friends and relatives are welcome to come.

產.o: Phonosemantic compound. 生 represents the meaning and 彥 represents the sound.

離.o: Depicts a bird (隹) being caught in a bird trap (罕). Based on the original meaning "catch a bird". The meaning later shifted to "reject", "separate", and "leave".

錢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 金 represents the meaning and 戔 represents the sound.

噢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 奥 represents the sound.
x: 噢，原来是这样！
Ō, yuánlái shì zhèyàng!
Oh, so that's how it is!
噢，我明白你的意思了。
Ō, wǒ míngbai nǐ de yìsi le.
Oh, I see what you mean now.

形.o: Phonosemantic compound. 彡 represents the meaning and 井 represents the sound.
x: 形势大好。
Xíngshì dàhǎo.
The situation is very good.
现在形势还是很严峻哪。
Xiànzài xíngshì háishì hěn yánjùn na.
The current situation is still very grim.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

院.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 完 represents the sound.
w: to be in hospital; to be hospitalized
the head of an institution whose name ends in 院
x: 哪个医院离这儿最近？
Nǎge yīyuàn lí zhèr zuìjìn?
Which hospital is closest to here?
伤者已被送往医院。
Shāngzhě yǐ bèi sòng wǎng yīyuàn.
The injured have been taken to hospital.

c.h: Shorthand for the 專 component in the traditional character 團.

团.o: Simplified form of 團. Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 專 represents the sound.
x: 你们这团儿都安排了什么项目啊？
Nǐmen zhèi tuánr dōu ānpái le shénme xiàngmu a?
What kind of programs do you provide for this tour group?
她代表学生团体发言。
Tā dàibiǎo xuéshēng tuántǐ fāyán.
She made a statement on behalf of the student group.

止.o: Pictograph of a foot. The meaning of this character has shifted over time and now means "stop".
w: to stop; to halt; to cease
to prohibit; to forbid; to ban
to close; to stop; to put a stop to sth
x: 赶快停止你的动作，否则我们要开枪了！
Gǎnkuài tíngzhǐ nǐ de dòngzuò, fǒuzé wǒmen yào kāiqiāng le!
Stop what you are doing or we'll open fire!
禁止吸烟。
Jìnzhǐ xīyān.
No smoking.
患病期间禁止行房。
Huànbìng qījiān jìnzhǐ xíngfáng.
Refrain from intercourse during recovery.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

红.o: Simplified form of 紅. Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 工 represents the sound.
w: money wrapped in red as a gift; bonus payment
x: 迈克尔·杰克逊没有以前那么红了。
Màikè'ěr Jiékèxùn méiyǒu yǐqián nàme hóng le.
Michael Jackson is not as popular as he used to be.
恭喜发财，红包拿来！
Gōngxǐ fācái, hóngbāo ná lái!
(a cheeky request for a red packet of lucky money)
粉红色是红色和白色的混合色。
Fěnhóngsè shì hóngsè hé báisè de hùnhé sè.
Pink is the mixed colour of red and white.

勢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 力 represents the meaning and 埶 represents the sound.

客.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 各 represents the sound.
x: 我家来了个客人。
Wǒ jiā lái le ge kèrén.
A guest has come to visit my home.
客人来了。
Kèrén lái le.
The guest is here.
别怪我对你不客气。
Bié guài wǒ duì nǐ bù kèqi.
I won't be responsible for my actions. (used as a warning)

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

探.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 罙 represents the sound.
w: to probe; to take readings; to explore
to explore; to go on an expedition; adventure
to visit; to call on sb; to look around
x: 上年我探望过一些非洲的贫穷家庭。
Shàngnián wǒ tànwàng guò yīxiē Fēizhōu de pínqióng jiātíng.
I visited some impoverished families in Africa last year.
放假了，我们一家大小往乡下去探望祖母。
Fàngjià le, wǒmen yījiādàxiǎo wǎng xiāngxià qù tànwàng zǔmǔ.
We had a holiday, so our whole family went to the countryside to visit grandmother.

c.h: Depicts a person (人) with an emphasized eye (𥄕).
Originally 爿, which depicted a bed. Later reanalyzed as meaning component 夕 (evening).

夢.o: Depicts a person with an emphasized eye (𦰋) sleeping on a bed (爿), conveying the meaning "dream". 𦰋 also represents the sound. The 爿 (bed) component was later reanalyzed as meaning component 夕 (evening).

c.h: Shells were used as currency in ancient China.

赢.o: Simplified form of 贏. Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 𣎆 represents the sound.
w: gain; profit; to make a profit
x: 庄家永远是赢家。
Zhuāngjiā yǒngyuǎn shì yíngjiā.
The house always wins.
啊！我又赢了！
Ā! Wǒ yòu yíng le!
Ha! I've won again!

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴. Depicts a hand holding a hunting weapon.

敢.o: Depicts a hand holding a hunting weapon (攵) catching a wild boar (豕). 甘 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "to hunt; to pursue". The meaning later shifted to "brave" and "to dare".
w: to have the courage to do sth; to dare to
actually; as it turns out; indeed
x: 我们必须敢想，敢说，敢干。
Wǒmen bìxū gǎn xiǎng, gǎn shuō, gǎn gàn.
We must dare to think, speak up and act.
你要去参加，而且你还要敢于发言，敢于辩论。
Nǐ yào qù cānjiā, érqiě nǐ hái yào gǎnyú fāyán, gǎnyú biànlùn.
You are going to participate – and you will dare to speak and debate.
他不敢正眼看她。
Tā bù gǎn zhèng yǎnkàn tā.
He didn't dare to look at her in the face.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

换.o: Simplified form of 換. Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 奐 represents the sound.
w: to exchange; to swap; to switch (telecom)
to change; to switch; to convert
to transform; to convert; to vary
to exchange; to replace; to substitute for
x: 一百元人民币能换多少港币？
Yībǎi yuán rénmínbì néng huàn duōshào gǎngbì?
How many Hong Kong dollars can one hundred renminbi be exchanged for?
他怀疑电视里的主播已经被伪人替换了。
Tā huáiyí diànshì lǐ de zhǔbō yǐjīng bèi wěirén tìhuàn le.
He suspected that the anchor on TV had been replaced by an alterative.

檢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 僉 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "label on a book". The meaning later shifted to "arrange" and "examine".

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

波.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 皮 represents the sound.
w: to undulate; to fluctuate; wave motion
to rush about; to be constantly on the move
x: 没有微波炉怎样加热饭菜？
Méiyǒu wēibōlú zěnyàng jiārè fàncài?
How do you reheat meals without a microwave?
海面波涛汹涌，近半数旅客晕船。
Hǎimiàn bōtāoxiōngyǒng, jìn bànshù lǚkè yùnchuán.
The sea was rough and nearly half of the passengers were seasick.

c.h: In ancient China, shells were used as currency.

财.o: Phonosemantic compound. 贝 represents the meaning and 才 represents the sound. Simplified form of 財.
x: 君子爱财，取之有道。
Jūnzǐ ài cái, qǔ zhī yǒu dào.
A nobleman makes fortune in a noble way.
知识分子是国家的宝贵财富。
Zhīshifènzǐ shì guójiā de bǎoguì cáifù.
Educated people are valuable assets to the country.
他在赌场发财了。
Tā zài dǔchǎng fācái le.
He made a pile at the casino.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

慢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 曼 represents the sound.
w: take your time; take it easy
x: 你能开慢一点吗？
Nǐ néng kāi màn yīdiǎn ma?
Can you drive slower?
慢性肾炎难以自愈。
Mànxìng shènyán nányǐ zìyù.
Chronic nephritis rarely heals by itself.
这表慢了三分钟。
Zhè biǎo màn le sān fēnzhōng.
This watch is three minutes slow.

c.h: Depicts two hands twisting a rope.

索.o: Pictograph of two hands (廾) twisting together a long rope (糸). The meaning later expanded to "search" and "demand".
w: to retrieve (data); to look up; retrieval
to ask for compensation; to claim damages
x: 索尼大法好，天灭任地狱
Suǒní dàfǎ hǎo, tiān miè Rèndìyù
Praise Sony, and may Heaven destroy Nintendo.
既然已经帮助他了，就索性帮到底。
Jìrán yǐjīng bāngzhù tā le, jiù suǒxìng bāng dàodǐ.
Since we've already helped him out, we might as well help until the job is done.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

漢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 𦰩 represents the sound.

c.h: Depicts a person with their open mouth facing backwards.

既.o: Depicts a person, who is full, turning away (旡) from a container of food (皀). Based on the original meaning "finish eating". The meaning later shifted to "complete" and "already".
w: since; as; this being the case
just as in the past (idiom); as before
x: 她既漂亮，又聪明可爱！
Tā jì piàoliàng, yòu cōngmíng kě'ài!
She's beautiful, smart, and cute!
既然你们都已经想清楚了，那我尊敬你们的意愿。
Jìrán nǐmen dōu yǐjīng xiǎng qīngchu le, nà wǒ zūnjìng nǐmen de yìyuàn.
Considering you have all thought it through, I will respect your wishes.
既然已经帮助他了，就索性帮到底。
Jìrán yǐjīng bāngzhù tā le, jiù suǒxìng bāng dàodǐ.
Since we've already helped him out, we might as well help until the job is done.

蠢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 春 represents the sound and 䖵 represents the meaning.
w: to begin to stir (idiom); to get restless
to wriggle; to stir up trouble
x: 你看她，大家都叫她「愚蠢的老太婆」。
Nǐ kàn tā, dàjiā dōu jiào tā “yúchǔn de lǎotàipó”.
Look at her; everyone calls her "stupid old hag".
他因为自己的愚蠢，多次错过了弥补亏损的机会。
Tā yīnwèi zìjǐ de yúchǔn, duōcì cuòguò le míbǔ kuīsǔn de jīhuì.
Because of his stupidity, he missed multiple opportunities to regain his losses.

丢.o: A horizontal line, depicting an item being discarded, added to the semantically similar character 去 (leave; go).
w: to lose; to throw away; to discard
to make an exhibition of oneself
x: 他四处寻找丢失的钥匙。
Tā sìchù xúnzhǎo diūshī de yàoshi.
He looked here and there for the missing keys.
我来不会给你丢脸吧。
Wǒ lái bù huì gěi nǐ diūliǎn ba.
Me being here won't cause you to lose face, will it?
太丢人了。
Tài diūrén le.
It was so embarrassing.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

抢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 仓 represents the sound. Simplified form of 搶.
w: to snatch (esp related to a robbery)
to rush (to do sth urgent); to forestall
to plunder; to pillage; to forcibly take
x: 我的手机被抢走了。
Wǒ de shǒujī bèi qiǎng zǒu le.
My phone was snatched.
抢救无效。
Qiǎngjiù wúxiào.
All rescue measures proved ineffectual.
他迅速抢夺了桌上的最后一块蛋糕。
Tā xùnsù qiǎngduó le zhuō shàng de zuìhòu yīkuài dàngāo.
He quickly snatched the last piece of cake on the table.

c.g: net for catching birds or rabbits
c.h: Depicts a net with a handle for catching birds or rabbits.

畢.o: Depicts a of hunting net (𠦒) used in a field (田) to catch birds or rabbits. Based on the original meaning "hunting net". The meaning later shifted to "finish".

廢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 广 represents the meaning and 發 represents the sound.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

订.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 丁 represents the sound. Simplified form of 訂.
w: to agree to and sign (a treaty etc)
to place an order; to book ahead
to place an order; to subscribe
x: 立法会可借决议修订附表。
Lìfǎhuì kě jiè juéyì xiūdìng fùbiǎo.
The Legislative Council may, by resolution, amend the Schedule.
他们没有经过思考就签订了合同。
Tāmen méiyǒu jīngguò sīkǎo jiù qiāndìng le hétong.
Without thinking it over, they signed the contract.

c.h: Originally a pictograph of an animal pen. Later reanalyzed as 宀 (roof).

牢.o: Depicts an animal, such as a cow (牛), trapped around an animal's fence (宀).
w: to keep in mind; to remember
x: 亡羊补牢，犹未迟也。
Wáng yáng bǔ láo, yóu wèi chí yě.
Repairing a sheep pen only after a sheep is lost is not considered tardy.
那囚犯被关在单人牢房内。
Nà qiúfàn bèi guān zài dānrén láofáng nèi.
The prisoner was locked in a cell.

c.h: Shorthand for the 能 component in the traditional character 罷.

罢.o: Simplified form of 罷. Depicts a tired bear (能) trapped under a net (网). Based on the original meaning "tired, wear out". The meaning later shifted to "stop" and "quit".
w: a modal particle indicating (that's all, only, nothing much)
a strike; to go on strike
to give up; to abandon (a goal etc)
to remove sb from their post; to dismiss
x: 他受你如此侮辱，怎肯善罢甘休？
Tā shòu nǐ rúcǐ wǔrǔ, zěn kěn shànbàgānxiū?
As you have insulted him, he won't let you go easily.

踢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 易 represents the sound.
w: lit. to punch and kick (idiom); to beat up
x: 他踢进了一个球。
Tā tī jìn le yī ge qiú.
He kicked a goal.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

恢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 灰 represents the sound.
w: to reinstate; to resume; to restore
lit. heaven's net has wide meshes, but nothing escapes it (idiom,…
x: 他的身体已经恢复了健康。
Tā de shēntǐ yǐjīng huīfù le jiànkāng.
He has already recovered his health.
病人现在还在恢复期。
Bìngrén xiànzài hái zài huīfùqī.
The patient is still in the recovery period.

c.h: The traditional component 皿 was removed for simplification.

卢.o: Simplified form of 盧. Originally a pictograph of a stove, based on the original meaning "stove", now written as 爐. The 虍 and 皿 components were added later. In modern Mandarin this character is usually only used for its sound in foreign loan words.
x: 卢布是俄罗斯的货币。
Lúbù shì Éluósī de huòbì.
The ruble is the currency of Russia.
他把人民币换成了卢比。
Tā bǎ rénmínbì huànchéng le lúbǐ.
He exchanged his renminbi for rupees.

貢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 工 represents the sound.

塢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 土 represents the meaning and 烏 represents the sound.

c.h: 钅 is a component form of 金.

钢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 钅 represents the meaning and 冈 represents the sound. Simplified form of 鋼.
x: 我钢琴弹得不好，见笑了。
Wǒ gāngqín tán de bù hǎo, jiànxiào le.
Please excuse my poor piano performance. [humble]
我妈逼我学钢琴。
Wǒ mā bī wǒ xué gāngqín.
My mom forced me to learn the piano.

詢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 旬 represents the sound.

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

询.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 旬 represents the sound. Simplified form of 詢.
w: to consult; to seek advice; consultation
to consult; to query; to solicit opinion
to inquire into; to ask after
x: 我想咨询一下签证的问题。
Wǒ xiǎng zīxún yīxià qiānzhèng de wèntí.
I'd like to ask about a visa question.
他向老师询问了考试时间。
Tā xiàng lǎoshī xúnwèn le kǎoshì shíjiān.
He asked the teacher about the exam time.

賢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 貝 represents the meaning and 臤 represents the sound.

暢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 申 represents the meaning and 昜 represents the sound.

闢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 門 represents the meaning and 辟 represents the sound.

c.h: 飠 is a component form of 食.

飢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 飠 represents the meaning and 几 represents the sound.

w: to meet again; to be reunited; reunion
extremely rare (idiom); once in a blue moon
to meet (by chance); to come across
every time; on each occasion; whenever
to just happen to coincide with
at the Chinese New Year or other festivities
lit. to meet face to face on a narrow path (idiom)
x: 过了许多年我们才偶然相逢。
Guò le xǔduō nián wǒmen cái ǒurán xiāngféng.
Many years were to pass before we crossed our paths again.

癢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 疒 represents the meaning and 養 represents the sound.

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

鏢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 票 represents the sound.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.

肢.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 支 represents the sound.
w: the four limbs of the body
to dismember; to break into parts
x: 运动以前要先活动四肢。
Yùndòng yǐqián yào xiān huódòng sìzhī.
Before exercising, you should first loosen up your arms and legs.
他说话时肢体语言很丰富。
Tā shuōhuà shí zhītǐ yǔyán hěn fēngfù.
He uses a lot of body language when he talks.

巢.o: Pictograph of a nest (甾) in a tree (木).
w: the whole nest came out (idiom); to turn out in full strength
lit. the whole nest came out (to fight us)
x: 覆巢之下，焉有完卵？
Fù cháo zhīxià, yān yǒu wán luǎn?
Under a rolled-over nest, how come that any unbroken egg exists? (rhetorical)

厢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 厂 represents the meaning and 相 represents the sound. Simplified form of 廂.
w: box (in a theater or concert hall)
wing (of a traditional house); side room
both sides are willing; by mutual consent
x: 乘客不得在车厢内饮食。
Chéngkè bùdé zài chēxiāng nèi yǐnshí.
Passengers are not allowed to eat and drink on the train.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

拢.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 龙 represents the sound. Simplified form of 攏.
w: to rope in; fig. to involve sb; to entice
to draw to oneself; to gather up; to collect
unable to conceal one's happiness, amazement, shock etc
x: 请大家向中间靠拢。
Qǐng dàjiā xiàng zhōngjiān kàolǒng.
Everyone, please move in towards the middle.
她把头发拢到耳后。
Tā bǎ tóufa lǒng dào ěr hòu.
She tucked her hair behind her ears.
她用手绢擦了擦眼泪。
Tā yòng shǒujuàn cāle cā yǎnlèi.
She wiped her tears with a handkerchief.
奶奶送给我一块手绢。
